desc:

desc: Tesla Megapack set of 4 with solar canopy. ~16 MWh of energy storage capacity (~4 MWh each). 30 kW solar canopy. To charge the Megapacks from 0% to full from this solar canopy alone, it would take around 100 days.

title: File:Solar landfill with Tesla Megapacks with solar canopies 3.webp
desc: Solar landfill with Tesla Megapacks with solar canopies. 1.5 Mw solar farm on used landfill. 240 Kw solar canopies over the Tesla Megapacks. 128 Mw/h Tesla Megapack battery storage. The solar panels could fully charge the Megapack site in about 15 days from 0%.
